# the contributor audit: invariant buffering, actual continuation, and parity strata

All results here remain auxiliary to OC. No complete sharp proof has been
found, and no minimum-response positivity is inferred from the audits.

## Sources and verdicts

Full analytic read PASS:

* `candidate 86dd5366456916a8`, Sections 1--12;
* `historical context (not an accepted premise)`;
* `candidate d750a370b2e831ee`;
* `candidate c6bafe9ff5de0861`;
* `candidate b096cc2ab4c584d9`;
* `candidate c3bb7df3660a88b5`;
* `candidate 75dd33535e246a34`.

The independent Slab full audit of root's
`candidate f7c05b2c30c8cfcb` also passes.
It is the new outer-existence dependency, not a numerical closing theorem.

the contributor independently reran the fixed-body buffer verifier (1,018 exact checks)
and the four-interval all-slope verifier (512 exact checks), both PASS.
Finite computations supplement the analytic proofs only. The latter all-
slope proof uses the complete finite breakpoint list and affine tails,
not a sampling assertion.

## Main checks

The invariant buffer is f=(E/M)^(1/(d+1)) with the WITHIN-fiber covariance
norm G(u)=sqrt(u^T Sigma u). Its ordinary source derivative is f a_opt;
its BODY derivative includes the normalization of M. The changing norm
must also be differentiated. All these terms are included in the updated
continuation theorem. They cancel under a common homothety, as required
by actual affine invariance. A positive energy credit alone proves no
normalized descent.

The global covering construction retains every actual old contact on a
fixed deepest-base face. It minimizes the old affine tangent gap minus
the updated buffered quantity over the FINITE set of sampled contact
fibers. It never replaces the minimum by a preferred source. Exact current
quantiles are then chosen from one scalar weighted-threshold equation.
Their monotonicity comes from the proper own sections, including when
other fibers have supporting traces. Thus the exact cover does not need
C1 cap mass, nesting, or a differentiable continued center.

The first derivative in the current source DOES require its stated signed
bounded radial shell hypothesis and regular selected cap expansion.
Uniform projective minimizers remain bounded and keep a common positive
denominator. The signed shell formula is uniform in these parameters.
Finite-contact envelope differentiation is then valid without a source-
velocity rate. Irregular supporting-facet inverse quantiles are being
proved separately and are not included merely by this audit.

The source/fiber compactness is genuine. Original bad-minor minimality
prevents normalized masses from vanishing because original depth is at
most buffered depth; only the original restriction inequality is used.
All normalization maps preserve the buffered objective. Positive limiting
fibers give covariance and energy continuity. Normalize u in Euclidean
length to compare varying bodies: the base tilt cancels because the
candidate's integer base is fixed. One uniform slab estimate therefore
controls ALL directions. A uniform small-epsilon choice on the entire
original bad sublevel precedes minimization and makes every maximizing
own trace proper. No epsilon is selected after finding an unknown minimum.

For parity saturation, repeated midpoint division is essential. A maximal
minimal-face witness of a given parity forces every site of that parity
onto its face; if all parity slots are occupied by the witnesses, each
successive midpoint must retain that witness's parity. Infinite divisibility
then forces coincidence. Therefore full witness saturation means exactly
parity-distinct vertices, and no nontrivial anchored relation remains among
the deepest witnesses themselves.

The maximal-face overlap components are precisely the anchored components:
any anchored representation of z lies inside its minimal face; the latter
lies in a maximal chosen face and connects every source. Each component
is complete and their parity sets are disjoint. Strict energy-power face
rigidity propagates through shared actual marked fibers. Every component
therefore consists of compatible translates of one full body.

For such translates, actual compatibility forces all integer-anchored
center relations. The graph hull has singleton integer fibers. The
occupied-parity weighted base center theorem lifts through those singleton
fibers by intersection of all large-weight graph hulls. This produces ONE
actual graph point, with closed boundary atoms retained. Ordinary Grunbaum
then gives an actual mixed center for each component. Taking the largest
of these numerical lower bounds proves

    Q_original >= gamma_d M_deepest/k(I).

The component centers are not averaged and need not be original deepest
points. This pays only the mass of the buffered deepest stratum. No proof
that this stratum exhausts all original fibers is present.

The four-interval counterexample retains complete sampling, convex roofs,
strict nonheaviness and all proper closed-minor count quotas. Its two
inner points are genuinely the only global centers by complete slope
tables and strict critical-cap shifts. Every regular critical circuit at
the first center lacks an interior common endpoint core. This blocks that
sufficient geometric selector even in the fully saturated two-witness
case. Its actual depth 55/211 is ABOVE 1/4; it does not refute OC or a
bad-depth-specific response theorem.

## Remaining obligations

The new minimum, source balance, quantile cover, and contact derivative
form a valid dependency chain. Its missing step is still a physical
response or structural theorem at a hypothetical bad minimum that retains
all nondeepest fibers and proves the exact gamma_d/k payment. Ordinary
source Grunbaum, covariance invariance, and parity counting alone do not
supply that theorem. No arbitrary continuous affine/projective change of
integer labels or replacement of fiber sums by an integral has occurred.
note: Mathematical discussion retained to expose corrections and limitations. This is not a verification run, accepted premise, or approval of the revised submission. Association follows explicit source-document references, not an inferred dependency.
